versions.content: Configurable record numbers and trigger options for DTCSnap- shotRecords and DTCExtendedDataRecords Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR module shall provide the capability to configure record numbers and trigger options for the storage of DTCSnapshotRecords and DTCExtendedDataRecords.
